title: Discharge Recommendation Contract (DC-DISCHARGE-RECOMMENDATION-v1)
description: Discharge-recommendation contract (Sprint 09 v2 draft per design spec §3.3 / FR-DC-001, FR-DC-006). Contract only; ingestion in a later sprint. Follows the dc-demand-encounter-v1 envelope pattern. Represents ranked, actionable discharge decisions derived from a DC-DISCHARGE-SCORE-v1 score; extends the reference ontology hcp:DischargeRecommendation ICE — see docs/ontology/reference-layer.ttl and docs/ontology/crosswalk.md v0.2.0. Related to DC-DEMAND-ENCOUNTER-v1 via encounterId; related to DC-DISCHARGE-SCORE-v1 via derivedFromScoreId. ADR-0013 westus2 demo-scope exception applies at the ingestion layer for synthetic data only; PROD PHI paths remain gated on Swiss residency per ADR-0003/0004. ADR-0016 gate 1: _pseudonymisation_flag=true is explicit at the dataset envelope for demo-scope contracts.

_pseudonymisation_flag.description: ADR-0016 gate 1: demo-scope dc-*.schema.json contracts must explicitly declare that all record identifiers are pseudonymised (no PHI). Enforced by policy_gate.py in the demo-scope profile.

recommendationId.description: Unique discharge-recommendation identifier. Maps to hcp:DischargeRecommendation in the reference ontology.

derivedFromScoreId.description: Link back to the DC-DISCHARGE-SCORE-v1 score this recommendation is derived from.

rank.description: Recommendation rank within the set of candidates for the same encounter; 1 = top-ranked action.

recommendedAction.description: Actionable recommendation. discharge-blocked implies at least one entry in blockers[].

description.description: Human-readable blocker description; must not contain PHI.

producedBy.description: Model run identifier (producedBy=ModelRunId per design spec §3.3).

expiresAt.description: Time at which this recommendation is no longer valid and must be re-derived.
